items.claim: Roman Dolidze has not been performing at his best recently.
items.quote: Roman Dolidze has not been looking the greatest recently.

items.claim: Sergey Spivak has excellent heavyweight wrestling, strong body locks, good takedowns, effective inside trips, and good top pressure.
items.quote: Sergey, excellent heavyweight uh wrestling, strong body locks, good takedowns, very uh effective inside trips, uh good top pressure.

items.claim: Vitor Petrino is an explosive athlete with good power and knockout ability.
items.quote: Vitor Petrino, explosive athlete, just look at him. Good power, good uh you know, knockout ability

items.claim: Vitor Petrino is a good counter puncher and possesses some solid wrestling of his own.
items.quote: good counter puncher, and he has some solid wrestling of his own.

items.claim: Vitor Petrino is physically strong enough to stuff takedowns.
items.quote: I think he's all right, and I think he's physically strong to stuff takedowns.

items.claim: Sergey Spivak will use the cage and clinching to trip Vitor Petrino down and use his superior grappling to his advantage.
items.quote: Spivak is going to use the cage, eventually trip him down, and and use that grappling to his advantage.

items.claim: Vitor Petrino is better at stand-up than Sergey Spivak and can land a shot to put him out.
items.quote: I think when it comes to stand-up, obviously, Vitor is is better than him, and he can definitely land a nice shot, maybe put him out.

items.claim: Anthony Hernandez has relentless cardio, an extremely high wrestling pace, and excellent chain takedowns.
items.quote: relentless cardio, extreme high wrestling pace, excellent chain takedowns.

items.claim: Gregory Rodrigues has huge power with 12 knockout victories, dangerous boxing combinations, and a large frame for the division at 6'3.
items.quote: huge power, 12 KO victories, dangerous boxing combinations, big you know, big for this division at 6'3

items.claim: Gregory Rodrigues has questionable cardio and looked slow and tired in the later rounds against Jared Cannonier.
items.quote: We saw what Jared Cannonier did to you in those last couple rounds when you couldn't finish him. And then you look hella slow, hella tired in those last couple rounds, and you get smoked.
